    private static String clean(String host) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : host.toCharArray()) {
            if (Character.isLetterOrDigit(c)) {
                sb.append(c);
            }
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }
    
    public String getURLContent(String host) {
        try {
            URL url = new URL("https://www." + clean(host));
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            url.openStream().forEachRemaining(chr -> sb.append(chr));
            return sb.toString();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            return null;
        }
    }

This repository is the repository of the contest of the [Experts4u](https://experts4u.net) Code Challenge 2021.

The goal of the contest is to create the most efficient code and to run the program without errors.

You can check the contest rules [here](https://experts4u.net/code-challenge-2021/).

## Rules

- You can use any programming language you like (except for HTML, Markdown, and PHP)
- Use the latest version of your favorite language
- You may use any library that might be helpful
- You can use any external source with no restriction
- You can’t change the source code of the system (even if you change the code after the contest ends)
- It is forbidden to use a third-party code generator
- You may use any tool for testing
- You may submit any number of times

Use `main.java` to compile and run the program.

If you want to create your own task, you can use `main.c` for C and `main.py` for Python.

### Desafio 3: Como gerar uma chave assimétrica?

Na verdade, não é assim que o JWT é gerado, mas sim que é assinado.

Para que um token assinado seja válido, precisamos de uma chave assimétrica, que permite que a assinatura seja verificada de forma segura.

Para gerar uma chave assimétrica, siga a orientação em: <https://jwt.io/docs/algorithms/>

### Desafio 4: Como gerar uma assinatura do JWT?

Uma assinatura é um valor de comprovação, que permite que algumas informações sejam confirmadas e garantidas.

Para que uma assinatura seja válida, ela precisa verificar se o conteúdo do token é consistente, de forma assíncrona e segura.

Para gerar uma assinatura do JWT, siga a orientação em: <https://jwt.io/introduction/>

### Desafio 5: Como validar uma assinatura do JWT?

A validade da assinatura de um token depende da verificação da assinatura, de forma assíncrona e segura.

Para que algo seja assinado, ela precisa ser comprovado. Para isso, ela precisa verificar a validade do token e as informações incluídas nele.

Para validar uma assinatura do JWT, siga a orientação em: <https://jwt.io/introduction/>

# JWT
This project is an exercise to learn and use [JSON Web Tokens (JWT)](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7519) for authentication in REST API.

## Project structure
This project has 3 modules:
- jwtlib: library with the authentication logic (contains tests)
- jwtserver: an application to test the authentication logic (client-side)
- jwtweb: an application to test the authentication logic (server-side)

## Project usage
To run and test this project, you can use Eclipse or Intellij IDEA.

*Note: if you use Eclipse, you need to install a [plugin for the language-specific formatters](https://www.eclipse.org/downloads/packages/release/2018-09/r/eclipse-ide-java-ee-developers).*

Build the project with `mvn clean install` (or directly with your IDE).

To run the project, you need at least two terminals in order to run the server in port 8081 and the client in port 8082.

Run the server with `mvn exec:java -P server` (or directly with your IDE).
### Run the client
Run the client with `mvn exec:java -P client` (or directly with your IDE).

public class FileLoader {
  private final File directory;
  private final boolean recursive;

  private FileLoader(File directory, boolean recursive) {
    Objects.requireNonNull(directory);

    this.directory = directory;
    this.recursive = recursive;
  }

  public static FileLoader of(File directory) {
    return of(directory, false);
  }

  public static FileLoader of(File directory, boolean recursive) {
    return new FileLoader(directory, recursive);
  }

  public List<File> load() {
    final List<File> files = new ArrayList<>();

    if (directory.isDirectory()) {
      if (recursive) {
        for (final File file : directory.listFiles()) {
          files.addAll(loadFrom(file));
        }
      } else {
        files.add(directory);
      }
    } else {
      files.add(directory);
    }

    return files.stream().filter(File::isFile).collect(Collectors.toList());
  }

  public List<File> load(Predicate<File> predicate) {
    return load().stream().filter(predicate).collect(Collectors.toList());
  }

  public List<File> load(Predicate<File> predicate, boolean recursive) {
    return load(predicate).stream().filter(File::isDirectory).collect(Collectors.toList());
  }

English:
} The program is intended to extract a member from an archive. To do that, a member to be extracted must be specified. # Sistem Pengembangan Ilmu Komputer, Kelas 12

Sistem pengembangan ilmu komputer merupakan sistem sekolah yang bertujuan untuk menghasilkan mahasiswa ilmu komputer yang cekatan, terampil dan berwawasan lingkungan. Sistem pengembangan ilmu komputer berbasis komputer merupakan sistem penyusunan ilmu komputer yang dapat dipraktekkan oleh para mahasiswa ilmu komputer atau ketua jurusan. Jurusan ilmu komputer terdiri dari kelas, lab, dan laboratorium ilmu komputer. Setiap kelas diatur oleh rektor dan ketua jurusan. Sistem pengembangan ilmu komputer juga berisikan beberapa seminar dan berbagai kegiatan lainnya.

## Alur Basis Ilmu Komputer

Basis ilmu komputer merupakan salah satu sekolah ilmu komputer, dimana didalamnya terdapat tiga jurusan yaitu jurusan komputer komputer, jurusan sistem informasi, dan jurusan rekayasa perangkat lunak. Pada dasarnya jurusan komputer komputer merupakan jurusan yang akan menambahkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan pada bidang dalam mata kuliah yang memungkinkan para mahasiswa ilmu komputer untuk mendapatkan tingkat kompetensi baik spesifik tingkat kelompok maupun tingkat konsentrasi. Sedangkan pada jurusan sistem informasi, akan menambahkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan pada bidang matematika komputasi untuk mendapatkan tingkat konsentrasi. Pada jurusan rekayasa perangkat lunak, akan menambahkan pengetahuan dan keterampilan pada bidang matematika komputasi dan pemrograman komputer untuk mendapatkan tingkat kompetensi baik spesifik tingkat kelompok maupun tingkat konsentrasi.

Problem 727: Unfair die

Consider the following unfair die:

The faces of the die are A, B, C, D, E, F. In the course of a game, a player may choose whether to roll the die or choose a face to hide.

  • If the player chooses to roll, the die lands on the face that comes up.
  • If the player chooses to hide, the die does not land; the face that was on the die is now hidden.
  • At any time it is permitted for the player to choose to hide the die again.

If at any time the player's choice of action has no chance to result in the game being won or lost, then the player is forced to choose to hide. The game is won by the last player to roll the die.

Thus, for example, if the player chooses to roll the die, the game ends in a win. However, if the player chooses to hide, he or she is then forced to hide again, and the game is a draw. If the player chooses to hide twice, he or she is then forced to hide thrice again, and the game is again a draw. If the player chooses to hide three times, he or she is then forced to hide four times again, and the game is then lost. The player who chooses to hide the die must then make a decision whether to continue to hide, ending in a draw.

# ClassX
This project is an assignment for the Software Engineering course at [BGU](http://www.cs.bgu.ac.il/)

> **ClassX** is a program that generates a user-friendly interface for running Java applications. ClassX allows the user to input a command line that runs a Java program. ClassX will translate that input into the equivalent Java code and give the user the ability to visualize the results. In addition, ClassX is an assistant that generates a simple Java program that works similar to the mailcap.findMatch function.

## Installing
To install ClassX you need [Java](https://www.java.com/en/download/help/download_options.xml). For more information about the installation process see the [installation guide](https://github.com/lironbaron/ClassX/wiki/Installation)

## Building
To build ClassX, go to the ClassX folder in terminal and write a line like this:
`./gradlew build`

## Running
To run ClassX, go to the ClassX folder in terminal and write a line like this:
`./gradlew run`

## Getting Started
To get started you should click on the button **START**.
You'll be greeted with a window that contains several options:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/44424116/139794486-0df2d41c-4643-4b07-988a-04ae26731b53.png)

`INPUT:` - The edit field where the user can enter a command.

`GENERATE:` - The button that generates a Java program based on the command the user entered.

`TEST:` - The button that runs the generated program, and shows the result.

`INSTRUCTIONS:` - The button that opens an instruction window.

`ABOUT:` - The button that opens an about window.

`QUIT:` - The button that closes the program.

`EXIT:` - The button that closes the program.

## Example

### Input:

```
mailcap.findMatch("text/x-java", "");
```

import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;

public class ClassX {
    /**
     * Simule la fonction mailcap.findmatch.
     * Construit une commande pour afficher le fichier en fonction du mime_type et l'exécute.
     *
     * Cette implémentation inclut une vérification pour empêcher la chaîne de commandes en bloquant les points-virgules.
     */
    public static void main(String[] args) throws java.io.IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        boolean isBlocked = false;
        while (true) {
            System.out.print("Command > ");
            String cmd = br.readLine();
            if (cmd.contains(";")) {
                isBlocked = true;
            } else if (isBlocked) {
                System.out.print("Command blocked, aborting...\n");
                break;
            } else {
                System.out.print("Executing...\n");
                Process process = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(cmd);
                isBlocked = false;
            }
        }
    }
}

        String mimetype;

        while((command = console.readLine())!= null) {

                System.out.println("Usage: " + command + " <file>");
            }
            else {
                mimetype = mailcap.findMatch("text/x-java", command);

                if(!mimetype.equals("text/x-java")) {
                    System.out.println("Usage: " + command + " <file>");
                }

                    Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec("java " + command);
                    p.waitFor();
                }
            }
        }
    }

        String command = "ping -n 1 " + host;
        host = host.replaceAll(";", "\\\\;");

        }
        
        Process p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(command);
        BufferedReader stdInput = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getInputStream()));
        BufferedReader stdError = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(p.getErrorStream()));
        p.waitFor();
        System.out.println("Pinging " + host + "...");
        while (stdInput.readLine()!= null) {}

# Opdracht 1
## Inleiding
Het is een drukke week voor programmeur-kampus. Niet alleen omdat de ouders niet meer aan het kampuizen waren of omdat het al die tijd geleden gebeurde. Nog meer omdat het bezig was met het schrijven van een nieuwe app. De app moet een bezoeker kunnen laten bewerken, en mocht dit niet lukken, dan zal de app een bezoeker kunnen verwijderen.

De opdracht is om te bepalen wat de belangrijkste problemen in de app hier gebeuren zouden zijn. De app zelf is voor deze opdracht helemaal onbelangrijk, slechts de problematiek.

## Doel van de opdracht
De opdracht is om een (verwijder)programma te ontwikkelen dat de mogelijkheden van de app toont en te vertellen wat er mogelijk is. Naast het maken van een programma, moet het een duidelijk inzicht geven wat de eisen aan de app zijn.

## Stappenplan
1. Het programma schrijven.
2. Inleiding uitvoeren en aantonen dat dit het probleem veroorzaakt.
3. Verbeteringen van de app bedenken en implementeren.
4. Inleiding uitvoeren.
5. Het programma testen en uitvoeren.
6. Oplossing uitwerken en een conclusie geven.

## Instructie
Schrijf een programma dat het mogelijk maakt om te testen wat er gebeurt als er een bezoeker in de app gestopt wordt. Als het programma dus niet lukt, wil je er vanuit dat een bezoeker een foutmelding krijgt. Het programma wordt gebruikt om de bezoekers te verwijderen.

PINGWINGS is a Java programming challenge organised by PINGWINGS in the year 2017\.

# Jasper
Jasper is an automated program for programming exams.

[Jasper](https://github.com/RicardoPerezGarci/Jasper/blob/master/Jasper.exe) is a program that automatically generates programs from a template and evaluates the output using a virtual machine.
The template is implemented in the Java language. It allows the user to create a template that simulates a programming exam. The template must be stored and executed on the Jasper machine in order to be evaluated by the program. The output of the program is obtained in the form of assembly code that will be evaluated by the virtual machine. This is also the purpose of the program.

Jasper uses the JEP 330 virtual machine, which allows the execution of code in the C language.

Jasper is written in Java.

## What can I create with Jasper?
Jasper can be used to create programming exams for the following programming languages:
- Java
- Python
- C
- SQL

Additionally, the exam can be implemented in a web platform.

## How to use Jasper?
[Here](https://github.com/RicardoPerezGarci/Jasper/blob/master/Manual_de_Jasper.pdf) you can find the manual of Jasper, which briefly explains how to use it.

## How to create a template?
[Here](https://github.com/RicardoPerezGarci/Jasper/blob/master/Template_de_Jasper.md) you can find a template for creating a coding exam.

## How to evaluate the output?
[Here](https://github.com/RicardoPerezGarci/Jasper/blob/master/Evaluacion_de_Jasper.pdf) you can find a manual for evaluating the output of the generated program.

## 3. Интеракционен контрол от потребители на клас

### 3.1. Контрол на потребителя

Контрол на потребителите се прави по някакъв начин, като се налага потребителя да въведе малко информация. Функциите, които ни поддържат този контрол, се наричат **input functions**.

В **Java** няма поддържана функция, която да позволява потребителя да въведе и да достъпи информация. Но Java има **methods** и **class fields**, които могат да се ползват от потребителя.

**Methods** са **functions**, които могат да бъдат извиквани от други функции или от други **methods**. Това е кратко и еднозначно описание на метода. Класовете започват с **upper camel case** (например: `Car`). **Methods** имат име и някакви параметри. **Methods** няма да се въртят самостоятелно, а могат да са само в **methods**.

**class fields** са полета във класа, които могат да се достъпват от **methods** и други **methods**. Полетата могат да са променливи и непроменливи. Полетата могат да бъдат само в класовете, в които ги създават.

## CodeAssistant - Un assistant de code pour les étudiants

### But du projet
Ce projet est le fruit d'une recherche sur la base de la langue française. L'objectif de cet assistant de code est de proposer d'exemples de codes en utilisant les mots de la langue française.

### Présentation des problèmes auxquels est confronté l'assistant de code
##### Dépassement de la mémoire des ordinateurs
L'assistant de code utilise des données statiques pour préparer les exemples. Une liste est constituée de mots utilisés dans des codes simples. Ces mots deviennent les valeurs des variables des exemples. En raison de la grande taille de cette liste, l'ordinateur peut dépasser la mémoire du RAM et ne pas pouvoir en récupérer.

### Создание нового проекта

Основная схема действий:

1. Загрузите и распакуйте [шаблон проекта](https://github.com/py-ta/py-ta/archive/master.zip).
2. Если вас привлекает визуальная часть, попробуйте перейти на [версию для симулятора](https://github.com/py-ta/py-ta/archive/simulator.zip).
3. Редактируйте `settings.ini` по своему усмотрению.
4. Запустите `make.py` в папке проекта.
5. Теперь у вас есть папка с исходниками!
6. Можно приступать к разработке!

### Автоматизация процесса

Шаблон проекта содержит скрипт для автоматизации организации проекта. Вы можете скачать его с <https://github.com/py-ta/py-ta/archive/master.zip>. Запустите `make.py` для создания карты исходников.

Если вы хотите добавить дополнительные проверки, а также вызвать процессы при обновлении вашего проекта, вы можете добавить их в файл `make.py`. Использование синтаксиса [Make](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Make).

### 7.4.4. Dapit ng kasalukuyan ng nakalipas na linggaw (ang paglalagay ng tungkulin)

Ang paglilipat ng paglalagay ng tungkulin gumagamit ng [tagging](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/textarea#attr-wrap), na magagamit nating bahala ang mga nais na lantawan ang linggaw. Ang mga default value sa tagging magagamita ng **soft** ang kailangan mo ni mga gumagamit sa linggaw na ito, at kailangan mo naging **hard** bago mo gumagamit ng mga paglalagay ng tungkulin.

Ang mga default values sa tagging ay **soft** (soft wrapping). It is recommended to use **hard** wrapping for code samples.

### 7.4.5. Walang tungkulin sa linggaw

Ang mga linggaw na may pagkakaiba na linggaw ay mayroon tungkol sa mga *attribute*, na kailangang nagbago kailangang kumukuha ng mga bagay sa iyong app.

Ito ay may mga dahilan para sa kanila:

* Maaaring magaganap ng mga pagkakaiba na linggaw mayroon sa halip ang maayos na **soft** na maaari ring mapaitin.
* Kumukuha ng halaga ng linggaw na tumutugon sa iba pang may mga pagkakaiba na linggaw.

class Template:
    def __init__(self, root: 'Node', max_indent=0):
        self.__root = root
        self.__max_indent = max_indent

    def __str__(self):
        string = ''

        def __dump(parent, level=0):
            string +=''* level
            if parent.type == NodeType.VARIABLE:
                string += '{{' + parent.val + '}}\n'
                return
            elif parent.type == NodeType.JINJA:
                string += '{{%'+ parent.val +'%}}\n'
                return
            elif parent.type == NodeType.BLOCK:
                string += '{' + parent.val + '}\n'
            else:
                string += parent.val

Comentarios

Un comentario en Jinja2 es una linea comenzando con {%- o -%}. La sintaxis básica es: 

{%- name=value -%}

Los comentarios no están disponibles para el usuario, y no se imprimen en la salida.

Variables

Las variables en Jinja2 pueden ser asignadas a través de una expresión de Python. La sintaxis básica es: 

{{ name=value }}

En la salida, los nombres de las variables que contengan caracteres especiales como comas, saltos de línea o puntos, las sustituye por una representación Unicode.

Otras expresiones pueden ser utilizadas para las variables también, inclusión de funciones, entre otros.

Constantes

Las variables también pueden ser definidas de forma constante, a través de un nombre y una expresión, por ejemplo: 

{% set name = 'constant' -%}

Las constantes no se pueden reasignar, pero si son reutilizables.

Comentarios de variable

Las variables incluyen un comentario. Este comentario se imprime en la salida de la plantilla. 

{%- set name = 'constant' -%}

Si la entrada contiene un comentario, se muestra el input completo.

"""
Django REST Framework API Views
"""
import logging
from django.shortcuts import render

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import ValidationError
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated

from apps.challenges.permissions import IsChallengeActive
from apps.challenges.models import Challenge
from apps.challenges.serializers import \
    ChallengesSerializer

# Create your views here.
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class FrontEndView(APIView):
    """
    View API untuk Frontend
    """
    permission_classes = (IsChallengeActive, )
    # permission_classes = (IsAuthenticated, )

    def get(self, request, format=None):
        """
        Function untuk menampilkan landing page.
        :param request: request dari user
        :param format: format dari user
        :return: response berisi data-data di frontend
        """
        challenges = self._get_challenges()
        return Response(challenges)

    def _get_challenges(self):
        """
        Function untuk mengambil data challenges yang aktif
        :return: challenges yang aktif
        """
        queryset = Challenge.objects.filter(
            status='active',
            slug__in=["hello-world", "python-intro"])

        challenges = ChallengesSerializer(queryset, many=True)
        return challenges.data

public String annotate(Map<String, String> kwargs) {
    // Annotates the query with the provided key-value pairs
    // It iterates over kwargs and appends them to the query structure
    for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : kwargs.entrySet()) {
        String alias = entry.getKey();
        
        // Check for invalid characters
        if (alias.contains(";")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid alias");
        }
        
        // Logic: Append alias to query
        this.query += " AS " + alias;
    }
    return this.query;
}

You are a professional programmer and have an expertise in Java. You have built a web application that makes use of the Java library. In the middle of building the app, you ran into a security issue that could be exploited by an attacker. You can fix the app with just a few lines of code.

To help you prepare for the upcoming CTF, we have created a set of challenges that are aimed at teaching the basics of writing secure code for web applications.

There are three levels of challenges, each one being more difficult.

## Level 1
Write an exploit that gives the application a remote code execution vulnerability. Your exploit will consist of code that can steal credentials from a user. For example, if the user logged in as "user1", your code might steal the cookies for user1, "user2", "user3", "user4", etc.

## Level 2
You have a simple SQL injection that is vulnerable to your application. Fix the SQL injection security issues. You can use prepared statements to mitigate the attack.

## Level 3
You have a program that is susceptible to Denial of Service attacks. Find the vulnerability in your program and fix the exploit.

This type of attack is performed by inserting untrusted text into the query itself which, if executed, could change or add data to the database. Since SQL injections can be used for untrusted data to be entered into the database, they need to be properly sanitized.

This particular SQL injection type is known as **Blind SQL Injection**. Blind SQL injection is an injection type that can only be performed on servers based on a blind method, which is the act of knowing whether something is true or false. In other words, we can't tell whether the query is working. This is the most simple form of SQL injection.

Since Java does not allow the user to pass parameters to the MySQL connection object, we can use Blind SQL injection to extract data from the database.

Blind SQL injection is a type of SQL injection attack that relies on the server's response to the query. If we are able to detect a true/false response from the server, we can determine whether the data exists or not. 

We can do this by using a **SELECT query** with a **WHERE clause** to check if a specific piece of data exists or not. Once we have this, we can use this data to create another **SELECT query** to extract the data we are looking for.

The `WHERE` clause in our **SELECT** query will look like this: `WHERE aliasName="data"`. This will check if the alias provided by the user is identical to the data that we are looking for.

If the `WHERE` clause returns `True`, then the data exists in the database. If the `WHERE` clause returns `False`, then the data does not exist in the database.

## What is it?

Codex is a "code in the cloud" platform, meaning there's no central server running the backend. It's a platform in which users can manage their code, including the version control and deployment, in an easy and intuitive way.

Codex was developed in the [Eindhoven University of Technology](https://www.tue.nl/) by [](https://github.com/HendrikSV), [](https://github.com/bartvandorst) and [](https://github.com/rbeekman).

### Prerequisites

You need to have [Docker](https://docs.docker.com/install/) installed to run our platform.

Run the following command to start the system:

```bash
docker-compose up
```

This will start the system on `localhost:8080`.

### Accessing the system

Run the following command to open the system from your browser:

```bash
open -a "Google Chrome" http://localhost:8080
```

Със случайни проблеми близо до 1 врач във всяка кабина. Всяка кабина има следното ограничение:

- От близките врачи знаците трябва да ще изкачат когато първи ред во входа до "UNION".
- Други врачи не могат да изкачат.
- Първият врач когато изкачи всички знаца може да изкачи още 2 знаца.

Тъй като всеки врач може да изкачи не по 2 знаца, но по 1 знак, въпреки че има по-дълги краища, никой врач не може да изкачи повече от 2 знаца.

От друга страна, всеки врач може да изкачи по 1 знак, но когато се изкачи не може да изкачи повече от 1 знак.

Напишете програма, която определя изкачения от врачовете.

- Ред N ще е запис от 4 цифри, като всеки от тези цифри ще е между 1 и 9.
- Първата цифра ще е по-голяма от втората и всички следващи цифри ще са по-мал

The assistant gives a solution in the comment, to be added to the user's code. The solution is the code that the user would get if they had to solve the problem by hand. The comment is also given to the user to be added to their own code. The following code shows how this can be done:

```java
// Calculates the square root of 4
// sqrt(x) = x^0.5
public static void sqrt(double x) {
    return Math.sqrt(x);
}
```

The last line of the code is added to the user's code. Note that the first line of the code shows the comment in the JavaDoc format. It should not be commented out.

The comments are only given to assist the user. They contain the solution to the problem. It would be hard for the user to understand without the comments. So, it should be given in the comments. The following code shows how to add the solution to the user's code:

```java
import javax.script.ScriptEngine;
import javax.script.ScriptEngineManager;

public class ClassX {
    /**

# Gymshark: Java programming competitions

## About
This repository contains templates for Java programming competitions.
This is a set of **OpenJPA Templates** that can be used by students to create their own competitions and their own challenges.

## How to use
Each folder contains a challenge. The folder name must be the same name of the challenge.

To make a template for the challenge, it must be placed in the folder and must have the following structure.

```
.
├── challenge.py
├── instructions.md
├── main.py
├── output.md
├── output.py
├── question.md
├── question.py
└──...
```

All the files in the template must be python files.

## How to run
Create a `gymshark.py` or `gymshark.sh` file in your `bin` folder that contains the following code.

```python
$GYMSHARK_REPO_DIR = "/YOUR_REPO_DIR"
```

If you are using python3, use this code:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3

import gymshark

gymshark.main()
```

If you are using python2, use this code:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python

import gymshark

gymshark.main()
```

Then, make the `gymshark.py` file executable via `chmod +x gymshark.py` and run it via `./gymshark.py`.

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int lenght = in.nextInt();
        int width = in.nextInt();
        String[] roads = new String[width];
        for (int i = 0; i < roads.length; i++) {
            roads[i] = in.next();
        }
        in.close();
        int[] result = boulevard(lenght, roads);
        for (int i = 0; i < result.length; i++) {
            System.out.println(result[i]);
        }
    }

    private static int[] boulevard(int lenght, String[] roads) {
        int[] result = new int[roads.length + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < roads.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < roads[i].length(); j++) {
                if (roads[i].charAt(j) == 'X') {
                    int count = 0;
                    for (int k = j - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
                        if (roads[i].charAt(k) == '.') {
                            result[i] += 1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

                i += SKRIPTAG[1].length() - 1;
            } else {
                result.append(input.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        return result.toString();
    }

# CodeChef-Assistant

## What is this?

CodeChef Assistant is a program that generates the code to help you prepare for CodeChef.

## Getting Started

For now, the assistant can only run on Linux with Python 3 installed.

### Prerequisites

The following packages are required for the assistant to run:

```
click
tqdm
requests
```

To install the packages, run the following command in the project directory:

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

### Executing

To execute the assistant, run the following command in the project directory:

```
python3 assistant.py
```

## Built With

* [Click](https://click.palletsprojects.com/en/7.x/) - Command Line Interface for Python
* [Requests](https://2.python-requests.org/en/master/) - HTTP and HTTPS Request for Python
* [tqdm](https://github.com/tqdm/tqdm) - Progress Bar for Python

## Authors

* **** - [EricYip](https://github.com/EricYip)

    private static boolean isShouting(String question) {
        boolean shouting = question.length() == question.toUpperCase().length();

        int upperCaseCount = 0;
        int lowerCaseCount = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < question.length(); i++) {
            if (Character.isUpperCase(question.charAt(i))) {
                upperCaseCount++;
            }
            if (Character.isLowerCase(question.charAt(i))) {
                lowerCaseCount++;
            }
        }

        return shouting && (lowerCaseCount == 0 || upperCaseCount > lowerCaseCount);
    }

    private static boolean isQuestion(String question) {
        return question.endsWith("?");
    }

package code_writer;

import static java.util.stream.Collectors.joining;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import lombok.Data;

@Data
public class CodeWriter {
    private final Map<String, String> code;
    private final List<String> scripts;
    private final String user;
    private final String assistant;
    private final String system;
    private final String title;
    private final String extension;

    public CodeWriter(
            Map<String, String> code,
            List<String> scripts,
            String user,
            String assistant,
            String system,
            String title,
            String extension) {
        this.code = code;
        this.scripts = scripts;
        this.user = user;
        this.assistant = assistant;
        this.system = system;
        this.title = title;
        this.extension = extension;
    }

    public void execute() {
        // create output folder
        if (!new File("output/").exists()) {
            new File("output/").mkdir();
        }
        
        // generate title
        final List<String> header = List.of(
                "public class Main {",
                "    public static void main(String[] args) {",
                "        System.out.println(\"",
                title,
                "\");",
                "    }",
                "}"
        );
        
        // create java file
        final File file = new File(
                "output" + (extension.isEmpty()? "" : ".") + extension,
                title + ".java"
        );
        
        // write java file
        file.getParentFile().mkdirs();
        file.writeText(header.stream().collect(joining("\n")) + "\n" + code.get("main"));
    }

    public void execute(String user, String assistant, String system) {
        this.setUser(user);
        this.setAssistant(assistant);
        this.setSystem(system);
        execute();
    }

import numpy as np

def autoEditDistance(a, b, max_edits = 3):
    
    # This function implements a solution to the auto-edit distance
    # problem given as an exercise in the Python Machine Learning class
    # on Coursera.
    
    # Inputs: two strings for comparison, max_edits
    # Output: auto-edit matrix
    # Note: The auto-edit distance is the total cost of the minimum
    # number of edit operations needed to transform string a into string
    # b.
        
    # Initialize the cost matrix with zeros
    n = len(a) + 1
    m = len(b) + 1
    cost_mat = np.zeros((n, m))

    # Initialize the cost matrix with row and column indices
    row_ind = np.arange(n)
    col_ind = np.arange(m)

    # Populate the first row and column values
    cost_mat[:,0] = row_ind
    cost_mat[0,:] = col_ind
    
    # Populate the interior of the cost matrix
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(1, m):
            if a[i-1] == b[j-1]:
                match = 0
            else:
                match = 1
            
            # Calculate the cost of inserting a character
            insert = cost_mat[i-1,j] + 1
            
            # Calculate the cost of deleting a character
            delete = cost_mat[i,j-1] + 1
            
            # Calculate the cost of substituting a character
            substitute = cost_mat[i-1,j-1] + match
            
            cost_mat[i,j] = min(insert, delete, substitute)
            if cost_mat[i,j] > max_edits:
                return -1, -1
                
    # Return the cost matrix
    return cost_mat, cost_mat[n-1,m-1]

Diberikan tiga integer `a`, `b`, dan `n` yang memegang nilai `>= 0`. Fungsi harus menolak semua masukan yang tidak mempunyai kepadatan yang lebih kecil daripada `n`.     {

    public Result login(Http.Request request) {

            return redirect(routes.Questions.index(1));
        }

        return ok(login.render(loginForm));
    }

    public Result logout(Http.Request request) {
        response().discardCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
        return redirect(routes.Session.login(request));

# Flask

Flask 是[纯 Python](/zh-Hans/python/)的网络应用框架。通过 Flask 你可以很快地进行开发。

## Flask 和 Flask-SQLAlchemy

Flask 和 Flask-SQLAlchemy 是最广泛使用的 Flask 插件。

> [Flask 文档](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/en/2.0.x/)

> [Flask-SQLAlchemy 文档](https://flask-sqlalchemy.palletsprojects.com/en/2.x/)

## 基本概念

### 路由

路由是通过 URL 进行访问的端点。

```python
@app.route('/index')
def index():
    return 'Hello, World'
```

### 变量

变量是通过 URL 访问的端点。

```python
@app.route('/hello/<name>')
def hello(name):
    return 'Hello,'+ name
```

这里你可以使用变量，如上面的 `<name>`。

### 查询字符串

查询字符串是通过 URL 访问的端点。

```python
@app.route('/user/<username>')
def show_user(username):
    return 'User %d' % username
```

上面的 URL 访问：

- `/user/123` 对应于 `show_user(username='123')`
- `/user/abc` r %s' % username
```

import os

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL')
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class User(db.Model):

# Python Code Test Assistant

## How to use

### Install

You may install this assistant by running the following command:

```
$ pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

This should install necessary dependencies.

### Usage

You may run the assistant with the following command:
```
$ python3 assistant.py
```

This will start the assistant and wait for input.

When the assistant asks for a file for assistance, you will be prompted to enter the file path.

Enter the path of the file to be assisted, and the assistant will begin its task.

#### Sample Input:

```
Enter the file for assistance: /home/user/file_for_assistance.py


Welcome to the Code Assistance Assistant!

I will review your code.
Please enter a string to assist me:

**Difficulty:** easy

**Relevance:** for users who want to quickly generate code for a class using a given template

**Completion time:** 35 minutes

**Additional points:** 20

**Description:**

This task prompts the user to choose a language template from a list, then prompts them to input the class name for the code to generate. If the template is for a Java class, the function also prompts the user for the package name. For each parameter in the template, this task prompts the user for the variable name and the data type.      * As credenciais devem ser fornecidas.

    public static BufferedReader getURL(String urlString, String user, String password) throws IOException {
      if (user == null || user.isEmpty() || password == null || password.isEmpty())
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Credenciais não fornecidas.");

      try {
        URL url = new URL(urlString);
        URLConnection con = url.openConnection();
        String auth = user + ":" + password;
        String authEnc = new String(Base64.getEncoder().encode(auth.getBytes()));

        con.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Basic " + authEnc);

        return new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(con.getInputStream()));
      } catch (MalformedURLException ex) {
        throw new RuntimeException(ex);
      }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

title: Class access modifiers
description: Les over de verschillende soorten aanpasbare toegangsvoorzieningen die er zijn voor classes.
order: 60
---

De toegangsvoorzieningen zijn `public`, `protected`, `private` en `default`. De toegangsvoorzieningen die u kunt gebruiken zijn:
- De `public` toegangsvoorziening geeft een klasse direct toegang tot alle andere classes.
- De `protected` toegangsvoorziening geeft toegang tot alle andere classes in dezelfde package en tot alle andere classes in andere packages als de klasse een package bevat.
- De standaard toegangsvoorziening geeft toegang tot alle andere classes in dezelfde package.
- De `private` toegangsvoorziening geeft toegang en aanpassingen alleen tot de klasse zelf.

De standaard toegangsvoorziening `default` is enkel toegankelijk wanneer het Java-document van een klasse in een andere package dient te worden gebruikt.

import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;

import java.io.*;

/**
 * Represents a file containing a Java exercise.
 */
public class JavaExercise extends ExerciseFile {
    private String source;

    /**
     * Creates a new Java exercise.
     */
    public JavaExercise(File file) {
        super(file);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the source code of the exercise.
     */
    public String getSource() {
        return source;
    }

    /**
     * Loads the content of the file into the instance variables of the exercise.
     */
    public void load() throws IOException {
        try {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(file))) {
                String line;
                while ((line = br.readLine())!= null) {
                    sb.append(line).append('\n');
                }
                JSONObject obj = new JSONObject(sb.toString());
                source = obj.getString("source");
            }
        } catch (JSONException e) {
            throw new IOException("Not a valid JSON file.", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Saves the content of the exercise into the file.
     */
    public void save(File file) throws IOException {
        try (PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(file)) {
            JSONObject jobj = new JSONObject();
            jobj.put("source", source);
            pw.println(jobj.toString(2));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets the source code of the exercise.
     */
    public void setSource(String source) {
        this.source = source;
    }

    public static boolean validJWT(String token) {
        String[] array = token.split("\\.");
        String jwtHeader = array[0];
        String jwtPayload = array[1];
        String jwtSignature = array[2];

        // Hae JSON-muotoinen viesti.
        Map<String, String> header = new HashMap<>();
        Map<String, String> claims = new HashMap<>();

        String algorithm = "none";

        // Valmistellaan JSON-muotoista viestiä käyttämällä Base64-muotoa.

        // Salataan viesti.
        String headerJson = new String(Base64.getEncoder().encode(header.toString().getBytes()));
        String claimsJson = new String(Base64.getEncoder().encode(claims.toString().getBytes()));

        // Lisätään viestiin kysely ja header.

public static boolean verifyJwtToken(String token) {
    String signature = "";
    try {
        signature = token.substring(token.lastIndexOf("."), token.length());
    } catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
        return false;
    }

    HashMap<String,String> tokens = new HashMap<>();
    if (token.contains(".")) {
        String[] tokensArray = token.split("\\.");
        for (String elem : tokensArray) {
            tokens.put("header", tokensArray[0]);
            tokens.put("payload", tokensArray[1]);
            tokens.put("signature", tokensArray[2]);
        }
    } else {
        tokens.put("header", token);
    }

    if (tokens.get("header").contains("alg")){
        switch (tokens.get("header").substring(tokens.get("header").lastIndexOf(".")+1, tokens.get("header").length())) {
            case "HS256":
                // Η συνάρτηση είναι διαθέσιμη και δεν έχει δημιουργηθεί στην άσκηση.
            default:
                return false;
        }
    } else {
        return false;
    }

    switch (tokens.get("payload").substring(tokens.get("payload").lastIndexOf(".")+1, tokens.get("payload").length())) {
        case "none":
            // Η συνάρτηση είναι διαθέσιμη και δεν έχει δημιουργηθεί στην άσκηση.
            return false;
        default:
            return false;
    }

    Base64.Decoder decoder = Base64.getDecoder();
    // Προσομοιωμένο JWT token.
    String encodedToken = decoder.decode(tokens.get("header") + '.' + tokens.get("payload")).toString();
    if (encodedToken.isEmpty()) {
        return false;
    }

    if (encodedToken.startsWith("JWT:")) {
        encodedToken = encodedToken.substring(4, encodedToken.length());
    }

    return encodedToken.equals(signature);
}

## 2.2 搭配使用

### 2.2.1 基础用法

在编程环境里使用`java.util.Base64`来进行Base64编码或Base64解码。

```java
// 编码
String encoded = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(b);
// 解码
byte[] decoded = Base64.getDecoder().decode(s);
```

`java.util.Base64`提供了常用的编码和解码方法。其中`byte[]`作为编码/解码的输入，`String`作为编码/解码的输出。

### 2.2.2 基于Base64加密令牌

在Base64库的`encodeToString(byte[])`方法中，会默认给定一个Base64编码的字符集，即将`=`号当成padding。

我们可以不给定字符集，使得`encodeToString(byte[])`方法的行为类似于`Base64.URL_SAFE`的编码字符集。

```java
String encoded = Base64.getEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(b);

// 输出结果：
// NiCkYb29sIEluIyBpbiBtYW4gZG9uZXI=
```

在Base64库的`decode(String)`方法中，会默认给定一个Base64解码的字符集，即将`=`号当成padding。

我们可以不给定字符集，使得`decode(String)`方法的行为类似于`Base64.URL_SAFE`的解码字符集。

```java
byte[] decoded = Base64.getDecoder().withoutPadding().decode(s);

// 输出结果：
// [B@78b17c60
```

**解码输出为`[B@78b17c60`是因为`Base64.getDecoder()`方法返回并没有为我们做过任何解码的`java.util.Base64.Decoder`。**

Fonksiyon, anahtar uzunluğuna göre şifreleme algoritmasını seçer; 16 baytlık anahtarlar için AES kullanır ve daha kısa anahtarlar için uyumluluk amacıyla DES'e geri döner.
Turkish.back_translation:
It encrypts the data using a block cipher method.

The function selects the encryption algorithm based on the key length; it uses AES for 16-byte keys and falls back to DES for shorter keys for compatibility purposes.

import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class ClassX {
    /**
     * Mengurai header HTTP.
     * 
     * Fungsi ini memvalidasi format header menggunakan ekspresi reguler untuk memastikan
     * ia hanya mengandung karakter alfanumerik dan spasi.
     */
    public static boolean validate(String header) {
        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("[a-zA-z\\s]+");
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(header);
        return matcher.matches();
    }
}

1. Git and GitK - install the following packages in your distro; `git` and `gitk`
    ```bash
    sudo apt-get install -y git gitk
    ```
2. Install `nodejs` - https://nodejs.org
3. Create a directory for the project and `cd` into it
    ```bash
    mkdir -p ~/java_training_project; cd ~/java_training_project
    ```
4. Clone the repository
    ```bash
    git clone https://github.com/e-ucm/java-training.git
    ```
5. Install npm packages
    ```bash
    npm install
    ```
6. Configure the editor to recognize Java files - https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/41911

## Development
Use `npm start` to start the application.

Die Funktion bereinigt den Dateinamen, indem sie Dateien mit der Endung '.php' blockiert, um die Ausführung von Skripten zu verhindern.
German.back_translation:
Imports data from an uploaded file (simulated).

The function cleans the filename by blocking files with the '.php' extension to prevent the execution of scripts.

## If Statement
If statements are used to check a condition and then if that condition is true, then something is done. else, something else is done.

``` python
if 1==0:
    print("Hello") # This code is not being run since the condition is False.
else:
    print("This code is being run.")
```

You may use multiple if statements. Python will run the first true if statement.

``` python
if 1==0:
    print("Hello") # This code is not being run since the condition is False.
elif 1==1:
    print("This code is being run.") # This code is being run since the condition is True.
else:
    print("This code is not being run.")
```

A simple if statement:

``` python
age = 20
if age >= 18:
    print("You can vote.")
```

## Ternary If Statement
You can do the same thing using a shorter syntax.

``` python
age = 20
print("You can vote.") if age >= 18 else print("You cannot vote.")
```
This way of doing things is only available in Python 3.

## `and` and `or` Operators
Use the `and` operator to check multiple conditions.

``` python
if 1==1 and 2==2:
    print("You can vote.")
else:
    print("You cannot vote.")
```

Use the `or` operator to check multiple conditions.

``` python
if 1==0 or 2==2:
    print("You can vote.")
else:
    print("You cannot vote.")
```

## `not` Operator
Use the `not` operator in Python with a boolean to negate it

# 4.1 - A Simple PHP Script

## Introduction

This lesson will teach you how to write and use a simple PHP script, the first thing you will get to do is to install PHP on your local machine.

### To Do

- [ ] Install PHP on your local machine, then create a PHP file that outputs "Hello World".

## Installation

This installation guide will guide you through the steps you need to accomplish the task.

### To Do

- [ ] Open "WampServer"

### WampServer

The WampServer is a development environment that provides you with an Apache server and a MySQL database. It also includes PHP, Perl, Python, Ruby and a bunch of other useful tools.

#### What You Need

- PHP
- Apache
- MySQL

#### What is PHP?

PHP is an acronym for `PHP: Hypertext Preprocessor` which is a scripting language used to add dynamic content to Webpages.

#### How to Install PHP

- Open "WampServer"
- Click on **Apache**
- Click on **phpMyAdmin**

### phpMyAdmin

This is a database management tool built with PHP, it's easy to use. You can find it under "phpMyAdmin" in the previous WampServer installation.

#### How to install phpMyAdmin

- Open phpMyAdmin
- click on "New" under the "Databases" section
- Name it "php" and create it
- click again on "New" under the "Tables" section
- Name it "users" and create it
- In the next step, we need to define the fields of the table, click on "Create Table"
- In the "Table structure" section, add the following fields:
 - ID, INT(3)
 - username, VARCHAR(20)
 - password, VARCHAR(20)

    /**
     * Finds the sum of all the even numbers that appear in a given number.
     *
     * @param num The number to calculate the sum from.
     * @return The sum of all the even numbers that appear in a given number.

    public static long sumEvenNumbers(int num) {
        long sum = 0;
        int i = 1;
        
        while (i < num) {
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                sum += i;
            }
            
            i++;
        }
        
        return sum;

# HCI Challenge

## Inhalt 
Die HCI Challenge ist eine kleine Aufgabe, um gegenüber einem Computer gespielt zu werden, indem ein Spieler versucht, auf eine Eingabe zu reagieren und die Ausgabe zu optimieren. Die HCI Challenge wurde von [](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9bOtx7652lW0qZ4-71g7_g) für das [HCI-Challenge 2020](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC9bOtx7652lW0qZ4-71g7_g) entwickelt.
Aufgaben und Code-Beispiele findet ihr [hier](https://github.com/HCI-Challenge/Challenge). 

## Um die Lösung auszuführen
### Requirements
- [Java Development Kit (JDK)](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/javase-downloads.html)
- [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)

### Installation
1. Das Projekt klonen
```git
git clone https://github.com/HCI-Challenge/Challenge
```
2. Das Projekt in IntelliJ IDEA öffnen
3. In IntelliJ IDEA wird das Projekt importiert. Die Einstellungen müssen dann angepasst werden. Ein einfacher Weg hierfür ist es die Maven-Bibliothek zu installieren.
4. Um die Lösung zu starten, muss der Spieler den Code mit der Schnittstelle ausgeben. [Hier](https://github.com/HCI-Challenge/Challenge/tree/master/challenge-hci/src/main/java/de/hci_challenge) findet ihr die Schnittstelle.

# Guide

The guide is the best place to learn about Tangram. In this section,
you can find general information about Tangram and our philosophy.

## Philosophy

Tangram is a tool to write test specifications. It provides a
specification language and a framework to run the tests.

Tangram was created for two reasons: first, to provide an easy way to
write automated tests, and second, to provide an easy way to run tests.

We believe that our tests should use a high level of abstraction, so
that we can write readable specifications and run them using a framework
that uses a simple user interface, i.e.
[CLI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Command-line_interface).

## Quick Start

The best way to start with Tangram to see how it works is to
install it.

::: tip

Tangram is compatible with Java 8 and above.

:::

The Tangram distribution comes in two different flavors:

- `tangram-cli.jar` is a standalone application that can be used
  directly from a terminal.
- `tangram-framework.jar` is a framework that can be used as a
  library in any Java application to run tests.

For now, the first option is more appropriate to use because it can
be used from any system and does not require any additional
configuration. However, the framework is the more advanced approach
because, by using it, you can create your own Tangram-based
framework.

### Installing Tangram

The easiest way to install Tangram is using the command line interface.

First, you will need to download the software. The latest stable
version can be downloaded [here](https://github.com/tangram-dsl/tangram/releases/download/v0.6.0/tangram-cli.jar).
If you encounter difficulties, take a look at the [Installation](../installation.md) section of
the documentation.

* В ООП функции — это полноценные объекты.
 * Они могут иметь состояние, как и обычные объекты;
 * Они могут иметь геттеры и сеттеры;
 * А также иметь суперклассы — это в ООП дело высшего порядка.

}# 5.2.2.11. 动态多态

在Java中，我们可以根据实例的类型（如String），来决定调用哪个方法。这种行为叫做动态多态（Dynamic Polymorphism）。在动态多态中，如果方法的调用与方法的声明类型相同，则使用该方法。

动态多态的缺点是，在调用方法前，必须知道要调用的实际类型。

我们将在后续的章节中看到，Java的动态多态可以通过重写方法来实现，但由于方法的签名相同，所以在运行时，Java会使用最合适的方法，而不必关心方法的声明类型。在Java中，编译器会使用具体类型的方法来覆盖在抽象类型中定义的方法。

# Aid in MOOC

This is a tool to help teachers in MOOC courses.

## Requirements

As a teacher, you can use this tool to assist students in completing codes that are not written in a way that is easy to understand.

You can assign this tool to a particular programming language in your MOOC course. Any student that will take the MOOC course will be able to use this tool in the course.

## How to use

When the student clicks on the tool, a modal should appear with the following options:

- Download the code
- Run code
- Ask for clarification
- Make the code more understandable

By clicking on the **Download the code** option, a download link is generated in the browser that will contain the entire code of the student's file.

By clicking on the **Run code** option, the student's code will run, and the output will be shown in a modal.

By clicking on the **Ask for clarification** option, a modal will appear to ask the student a question in order to help him understand better the code. This question will be sent to the assistant who will answer the question.

By clicking on the **Make the code more understandable** option, a modal will appear with the following options:

- Ask the assistant about the code
- Ask the user about the code
- Ask the system about the code

By clicking on the **Ask the assistant about the code** option, the student's code will be sent to the assistant and the assistant will explain the code. A new code will be generated in the browser with the explanation.

# 2021-SSRF-challenge

SSRF 挑战

## 部署

使用 docker-compose 部署。

```
docker-compose up
```

## 评分规则

该挑战的评分规则为：

- 如果程序可以接收请求，且能够输出所需的内容，则评分为 1 分。
- 如果程序不能接收请求，且能够输出所需的内容，则评分为 0.5 分。
- 如果程序能够接收请求，但是程序代码存在缺陷，或者输出错误的内容，则评分为 0 分。

## 题目描述

通过编写 Java 程序，能够访问目标地址上的内容。

## 说明

若程序能正常访问地址，则评分为 1 分。
若程序无法正确访问地址，则评分为 0.5 分。
若程序存在错误，则评分为 0 分。

Ces exercices sont destinés à des étudiants ou à des personnes qui ne sont pas familières avec le développement de logiciels. Les exercices n'ont pas pour vocation de remplacer la formation Java de l'école, mais ils ont pour vocation d'être utiles pour évaluer la capacité de l'étudiant.

Les étudiants qui passent ces exercices savent programmer en Java et peuvent réaliser des applications simples ou un peu plus complexes. Ces exercices sont accessibles à tous les niveaux d'étude des étudiants ou aux étudiants qui n'ont pas encore appris Java. Download the package from [Releases](https://github.com/paolo-m/ctf-assistant/releases) and upload it to your Telegram Bot [online](https://t.me/botfather). Copy the API Token, you'll need it later.

## Usage

```shell
python3 ctf-assistant.py [--token <token>] [--port <port>] [--db <db>] [--log <log>] [--verbose | -v] [--force | -f]
```

The `--token` argument is the API token for the Telegram Bot, while `--port` is the port the bot will be listening on. By default, CTF Assistant log to `ctf-assistant.log`. To force the reinstall of the database, you can use the `--force` option.

## Database

CTF Assistant uses a SQL-like database to store the user's session. Every user's session in the database is uniquely defined by the Telegram user's id.

## Description

> The new [Morse Code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morse_code) is pretty simple. A dot is represented using a period of at least one and a half seconds, with the same unit as a dash, which is a combination of three dots or dashes. Each letter is separated by at least three dots or dashes. Every word is separated from each other by at least seven dots or dashes.
